cd /home/czp/openvela_contest/packages/ai_agent; git commit -m "feat(remote-ctrl): adopt MQTT remote agent control, fix CJK font, strip rc_* loop

Replaces be459c0's rc_* MCP closed loop with the MQTT remote-control
channel (from feat/remote-ctrl), fixes the LVGL CJK crash that haunted
it, and removes the closed loop's firmware-side leftovers. The MCP
client, notify/toast, voice and LVGL work from be459c0 all stay.

## Remote agent control over MQTT (from feat/remote-ctrl, 2408f89)

The device drives a remote ACP agent (mimo 'mimo acp', or kiro-cli)
running on a PC through a bridge that speaks MQTT to the device.
- src/remote/: protocol state machine, JSON codec, session authority,
  MQTT transport — bounded messages, nonce/epoch anti-replay
- src/channels/remote_ctrl_channel.c: wiring, event handling,
  blocking-turn wait, transcript mirror (below)
- console commands: rask / rstat / rreply / rmodel / rusage / ronce /
  rdeny; config via set_remote <host:port> [device_id] and
  set_remote_auth <user> <pass> (persisted)
- LLM tools remote_agent_prompt (sync, 120 s turn) and
  remote_agent_status — deliberately NO approval tool: a permission
  decision is a human typing ronce/rdeny at this console, which is the
  point of the design
- tests/host/: protocol suite, no broker needed
  (cd tests/host && ./run_remote_link_test.sh)

## Reply/approval mirror onto the chat surfaces

rask replies now ride the cli outbound branch (console card, LVGL chat
view, beep/TTS voice pipeline) instead of syslog only, and a pending
permission pops the orange toast 'Approval: ronce / rdeny: <tool>',
same channel the notify service uses. ask-driven turns are not
mirrored: the local LLM presents its own answer built from the tool
result, and a raw transcript on top would say everything twice.

## Static MiSans-16 CJK font (fixes the recursive-assert reboot)

Runtime vg_font_create (FreeType/tiny_ttf rasterizing MiSans) wrote out
of bounds on complex CJK glyphs and corrupted the mm heap -> recursive
assert (arm64_fatal.c:571). The font is now pre-rasterized by
lv_font_conv into apps/graphics/lvgl/.../lv_font_misans_16_cjk.c
(3755 GB2312-1 chars; CONFIG_LV_FONT_MISANS_16_CJK=y in the goldfish
defconfig) and selected at init; the runtime load path is gone. Zero
runtime malloc, zero rasterization — nm shows no stbtt_/tiny_ttf
symbols and a full heap walk at boot no longer asserts.

## rc_* closed-loop leftovers removed

- 53 debug printf/fflush tracing lines; the four with diagnostic value
  (ASR text tracking, capture-start failure) became syslog lines
- fake 128 MB/96 MB heap figures in agent_mem.h and the disabled
  mallinfo in heap_info/boot log — restored to real mallinfo(); with
  the font fix the heap walker is clean again
- AUTONOMOUS EXECUTION prompt block and the auto-continuation nudge:
  both pushed 'never ask for confirmation' for git flows, conflicting
  with the human-only ronce/rdeny model
- LLM watchdog/socket timeouts reverted to 60 s/120 s — the 120/180
  bump only served the closed loop's inflated final summaries

## How to run (goldfish QEMU, verified end to end 2026-09-18)

PC side — broker + bridge (contest repo tools/acp-bridge):
  cd contest2026_272_tokenwujixian/tools/acp-bridge
  export DESKMATE_MQTT_USERNAME=deskmate DESKMATE_MQTT_PASSWORD=5006
  bin/deskmate-demo.sh bridge mimo mqtt \\

    --device-id goldfish-1 --mimo-attach --mimo-attach-port 4097
  (avoid --mimo-attach-port 4096: a running MiMoCode session holds it)

Device side, after 'ai_agent' at the NSH prompt:
  vela> set_remote 10.189.140.244:1883 goldfish-1
  vela> set_remote_auth deskmate 5006
  vela> rask <instruction>      # direct: MQTT -> mimo, reply mirrored
  vela> ronce | rdeny           # human-only permission decisions
  or let the local LLM delegate via ask; it calls remote_agent_prompt
  itself when the task needs the PC's files, repo or shell.

Build: CONFIG_AI_AGENT_REMOTE_CTRL=y (needs NETUTILS_MQTTC, already
default on goldfish). Verified: rask round trip with approval toast,
